proposition.P1: if host h exposes p(h) independently powered and independently addressed connector slots on its tool side, and device d occupies one slot unless it is externally powered or bus-shared, then the number of co-mounted devices k satisfies k <= p(h); with bus sharing k <= p(h)*m
proposition.C1: p(UR3e)=p(UR5e)=1 implies every k>=2 co-mount question is unsatisfiable regardless of how complete either side's declarations are
proposition.C2: completing Z3/Z4 can only turn unknown into compatible or incompatible; it cannot change the unsatisfiability of Z1
proposition.C3: FR3 keeps p undeclared, so its unknown pairs belong to Z4, are undecidable before completion, and must not be merged into Z1
